Sadly they are full up, all rooms are either taken by the Nurse Joys and their Part Time Helpers sexually servicing their clients. You're ready to just give up and settle for setting up camp in the woods until a buxom young woman approaches you.* Wait, Nurse Joy! I can take this one! *She walks up to you and the Nurse at the desk as you are mesmerized by her large breasts bouncing as she moves* Hey, my name is May! I'm sorry there's no rooms available at the Center, if you want to you can spend the night with me at my apartment building. I'm allowed to do that given these special circumstances.
